pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:198 The escape hatch from the render gate sends only a version id, so one press accepts every blocking finding on that staged version and no finding can be named or left blocking.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:198 The waiver's unit is the whole version, not one finding; two blocking findings cannot be split. The receipt (lib/script/versions.ts GateOverride) freezes counts and the blocking render ids, which limits the time reach but does not give finding identity.

app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Findings.tsx:13 Unmeasured and not-engaged render as their own marks, in one list shared by the render gate and the trailer check, so a skip never reads as a pass.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/PartEditor.tsx:7 The editor projects the server's verdict and computes no second copy that could drift from what is enforced.
app/(studio)/projects/[id]/[part]/_edit/Document.tsx:10 An override advances the version and writes the hole onto its record, as overrideFrom in fixtureScript.ts:183 does.
